sources:
[S1] (claims_submission.md) # Submitting a Claim Claims must be submitted within 12 months of the date of the expense. Claims submitted later are not eligible. **How to submit:** through the member portal or the mobile app. Upload a photo of the itemized receipt. Paper claims are also accepted by mail. **Processing time:** online claims are processed within 5 business days. Paper claims take up to 10 business days. **Payment:** reimbursement is paid by direct deposit. Set up direct deposit in your portal profile. **Large claims:** claims over $5,000 may require additional supporting documents and can take longer. **Direct billing:** many dentists, pharmacies and physiotherapists can bill Evergreen directly so you only pay your share.
[S2] (disability_benefits.md) # Disability Benefits **Short-term disability (STD):** pays 70% of weekly earnings up to $1,200 per week. Benefits begin after a 7-calendar-day waiting period and last up to 17 weeks. **Long-term disability (LTD):** starts after 119 days of disability (the end of STD). Pays 66 2/3% of monthly earnings up to $8,000 per month. For the first 24 months you must be unable to perform your own occupation. After that, you must be unable to perform any occupation you are suited for. **Claims:** your physician completes the medical statement. Submit it within 30 days of your last day worked. **Appeals:** a denied disability claim can be appealed in writing within 90 days of the decision. Appeals are handled by a human claims specialist.

[S1] (dental_coverage.md) # Dental Coverage **Basic services** (exams, cleanings, fillings, extractions): reimbursed at 80% on Standard and 100% on Enhanced. **Major services** (crowns, bridges, dentures): reimbursed at 50% on both plans. **Annual dental maximum:** $1,500 per person on Standard and $2,500 per person on Enhanced. **Recall exams:** once every 9 months for adults and once every 6 months for children. **Orthodontics:** reimbursed at 50% for dependent children under age 19, with a lifetime maximum of $2,000 per child. **Pre-determination:** recommended before any treatment expected to cost more than $500. Submit the dentist's treatment plan through the portal.
[S2] (group_health_overview.md) # Evergreen Life Group Benefits: Health Plan Overview Evergreen Life offers two group health plans: Standard and Enhanced. **Standard plan:** annual deductible of $100 per person ($200 per family). After the deductible, eligible expenses are reimbursed at 80%. **Enhanced plan:** no deductible. Eligible expenses are reimbursed at 90%. **Paramedical services** (physiotherapy, chiropractic, massage therapy): up to $500 per practitioner type per calendar year on Standard and $1,000 on Enhanced. **Waiting period:** new employees become eligible after a 3-month waiting period. Dependants are covered from the same date.
